caption: The drawing features a horizontal rectangular band with a light yellow background that has subtle, wavy, wood-like texture lines in a slightly darker yellow. Inside this band, there is a thin red border near the edges. Within the bordered area, a red vine runs horizontally, weaving in gentle curves from left to right. Along the vine, there are clusters of round red berries and groups of green leaves with darker green veins. On the right side of the band, the vine forms a decorative red bow. The rest of the drawing, outside this rectangular band, is empty and plain off-white.
title: Decorative Panel from Rail Car Interior
